worldcombat.skill.avalanche.summary: Pack every hit you have taken into a rolling heap of snow: while you carry the battered grudge it is doubled, and thicker stacks crash wider and harder, leaving frost on the ground.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.use.0: Press after taking a round of hits with a doubled blow
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.use.1: Crash everyone gathered around the target away at once
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.use.2: Leave frost underfoot where it lands
The avalanche deals about %1$s physical damage. While Avalanche is equipped, each time you take damage from a source other than yourself you gain a stack of battered (up to 5 stacks, lasting 10 seconds and refreshed and stacked by further hits); with any stacks the blow is doubled, and more stacks crash over a wider area with stronger knockback.

Roll forward up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick; on impact it crashes out a %3$s-block shockwave, knocking the target back about %4$s blocks for full damage while other non-allies nearby take about 70%% damage and 70%% of the knockback; frost is laid at the landing spot for %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.deepdrift.on: Deep drift on: shockwave radius ×1.25, knockback ×1.15 and the roll reaches about 12% farther, pressing the area; in exchange the hit is about ×0.90, the wind-up is 2 ticks longer and the cooldown is 8 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.deepdrift.of: Deep drift off: the hit is about ×1.06 and the roll finishes cleanly, putting all the weight into one blow.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s it spends %4$s PP to fire, then recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.growth.0: At level %1$s the avalanche power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.growth.1: At level %1$s the avalanche power rises to %2$s and the shockwave radius grows to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.preference.d: On: shockwave radius ×1.25, knockback ×1.15 and the roll reaches ×1.12 farther, pressing the area; but the hit is ×0.90, the wind-up is 2 ticks longer and the cooldown is 8 ticks longer. Off: the hit is ×1.06 and the roll finishes cleanly.
worldcombat.skill.avalanche.preference.a: Roll only at targets within this distance; raise it to close on more distant foes.
On: prioritise crashing out while you carry the battered grudge (exactly the doubled window); off: only prefer it when two or more foes cluster around the target.
